# Compaction memory retirement: review evidence

Public synthetic screenshots from the packaged Workbench built from
`7a91b9ee5d98f599064c00a4f6573f3b783511f7` in an isolated machine runtime.
The machine starts with the former experimental preference enabled. Its active
entry and switch are absent, while Progressive/Delta settings remain usable.
The backend is real; the native executable is deliberately unavailable and no
model Turn is run. This evidence does not claim installed behavior.

- Desktop: 1440 × 1000.
- Narrow: 430 × 932, no document overflow.
- Error: real backend rejects an injected stale revision; the confirmed switch
  remains on and a subsequent ordinary save succeeds.
- Chinese: the experimental capability remains absent after language change.

The capability list is populated with the shipped device settings; reload,
independent settings and error/retry states were inspected. Optional help stays
collapsed. The narrow view keeps the existing horizontal capability selector
and visible context switches; this removal does not redesign that layout.

These files are a revision-pinned PR artifact on a separate evidence branch,
not current product-guide media or a proposed merge into main.
